text: The in-app notification lint change adds mail/components/inappnotifications/** to the historical valid-jsdoc override and replaces typed @emits entries with untyped @fires entries. Its full diff changes documentation and configuration only. The fixed accepted NotificationManager still dispatches CustomEvent values with notification or notification-ID detail where needed. The requestnotifications listener calls InAppNotifications._updateNotificationManager(), which supplies current filtered candidates through updatedNotifications(). Event-tag syntax alone does not validate that caller contract. Read the current config for the affected file: eslint.config.mjs composes Mozilla flat/valid-jsdoc and declares custom-element tags. The older directory allowlist is historical context. Resolved inherited lint settings were not run. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran.
title: Check event contracts after enabling JSDoc lint
